title: DebounceInput
intro: DebounceInput is a omponent that wraps an input field with debounce functionality. This means that the input value will only be processed after a specified delay, reducing the frequency of expensive operations like API calls or state updates while typing.
tables: Time interval that will wait before invoking the onChange event after the user stops typing.
